provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Faraway rulebook (EN; refs are section names)

modules.name: Advanced variant
modules.note: Recommended after at least one game of Faraway.

steps.text: Add People from Below's Region and Sanctuary cards to their decks
Shuffle the Region cards; deal {n} facedown to each player
Each player keeps 3 and secretly shuffles the other 2 back into the Region deck
Region deck in the middle; reveal {n} cards
steps.note: One more than the number of players

steps.text: Shuffle the Sanctuary cards into a facedown deck beside the Region deck
Played a higher number than your previous card? Draw 1 Sanctuary + 1 per Clue you have; keep 1 next phase
Pick new Regions from the middle in order of the number played, lowest first
Remove the last Region in the middle, then reveal players + 1 new cards
Score right to left, flipping Regions one at a time; Sanctuaries last
Everyone picks a Region from hand and reveals it at the same time, left to right
